explication: OTOBO is a web-based service-desk and ticketing application. The principal workflow is customer or agent authentication, ticket lookup or creation, ticket handling, and a response through the web UI. Agents also manage queues, processes, calendars, and administration; administrators configure integrations and packages. The README additionally documents knowledgebase/FAQ and ITSM/CMDB capabilities. This map emphasizes the sampled browser-side architecture; backend persistence and several documented subsystems are included where the repository tree supports the capability, but their internal calls were not sampled.
